newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Coeur d'Alene view adjusted.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Coeur d'Alene view adjusted.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it lowered its 1996 EPS estimate on Coeur d'Alene Mines Ltd to reflect its assumption the company will discontinue operation of its Golden Cross operation in New Zealand.
--EVEREN also raised its 1997 EPS estimate on the company to $0.33 from $0.05 and lowered its 1998 EPS view to $0.32 from $0.46.

--"We continue to hold a favorable long-term investment opinion of Coeur's common stock. However, we maintain our intermediate-term neutral opinion," said analyst Todd Hinrichs in a report. Coeur was trading at 14-1/2, up 1/8.
